column2: That concludes my explanation of Arcaya, Angel.{wait}{clear}My apologies for telling you so much at once. I know it will be hard, but please do your best.{wait}{clear}Now then, may I have your orders for my search?{wait}{clear}
I see. Very well. Then may I have your orders for my search?{wait}{clear}
From now on, let me stay by your side, as a human.{wait}{clear}
Cecia
Yes...{wait}{clear}
Until death do us part... together, always...{wait}{clear}
Yes, of course...{wait}{clear}
Never... never let me go.{wait}{clear}
I love you...{wait}{clear}
!!{wait}{clear}
Ah!{wait}{clear}
W-wait, please!!{wait}{clear}
What?! A person?{wait}{clear}
...I'm sorry. I pointed my bow at you...{wait}{clear}
...Are you Cecia, who lives in this forest?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I am. Are you... an angel?{wait}{clear}
Yes. I am ＄＄＄＄＄＄, a messenger from Heaven.{wait}{clear}I came to see you, Cecia.{wait}{clear}
Me? An angel came to see me?{wait}{clear}

Yes. There is something I would like to ask of you.{wait}{clear}Great turmoil is about to rise across this world.{wait}{clear}With a great calamity that has not yet shown itself, the world is falling into peril.{wait}{clear}So I would like you to help me set the world's turmoil right.{wait}{clear}
Me, with an angel... So the legend was true...{wait}{clear}
The legend?{wait}{clear}
You don't know it?{wait}{clear}
They say Saint Diana, who protects this Reyforia Forest, was blessed by an angel and saved the world.{wait}{clear}
To think the same thing is happening to me as happened to Diana-sama...{wait}{clear}
Me, chosen by an angel... I can't believe it...{wait}{clear}
Will you fight alongside me?{wait}{clear}
Yes... if I will do...{wait}{clear}
I will serve you, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, Cecia.{wait}{clear}I will come again when I have something to ask of you.{wait}{clear}
Yes, I understand... I'll be waiting for you any time, Angel.{wait}{clear}

Um, Angel...{wait}{clear}Could you wait a little while?{wait}{clear}I have to tell the elders that I am going with you.{wait}{clear}I can't just leave the village on my own...{wait}{clear}And I need to prepare myself, too...{wait}{clear}
I really need you{n}
I'll come again{n}
Cecia, please. I need your help.{wait}{clear}
If you feel that strongly, Angel...{wait}{clear}
Then you'll fight alongside me?{wait}{clear}
Yes, if I will do... I will serve you, Angel.{wait}{clear}I'll tell the elders afterwards.{wait}{clear}If I am leaving the village because an angel chose me... they will forgive me.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, Cecia.{wait}{clear}
No, there's no need to thank me...{wait}{clear}I will do everything I can.{wait}{clear}
Then I will come back here another day.{wait}{clear}
Please do, Angel.{wait}{clear}I'll talk to them so I can be sure to help you.{wait}{clear}Until then.{wait}{clear}
Angel!{wait}{clear}
Have you thought it over?{wait}{clear}
